CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT
            rae.id,
            gd.totalDistance,
            sa.totalSteps,
            rae.startTimestamp,
            rae.endTimestamp
        FROM RunActionEntity rae
        LEFT JOIN GpsDistance gd ON gd.runActionId = rae.id
        LEFT JOIN StepsAmount sa ON sa.runActionId = rae.id
